instructions_to_main_agent: Implement routing for Home (/), Trade (/trade), Logistics (/logistics), and Consulting (/consulting).
Ensure the theme is light-dominant: background #FFFFFF and #F7F8FA with dark navy text (#13202B) and gold accents (#C8A44D).
Build custom 3D interactive canvases (using Three.js / R3F / Canvas 2D WebGL high-performance renders) for each vertical hero and home hero.
Implement scroll-pinned story stages with smooth step transitions and interactive stage indicators.

Include key sections on Home: Hero, Business Verticals (01, 02, 03 chapter cards), Sectors/Where We Operate, Capabilities, Network Flow, Future Focus (clearly tagged EMERGING FOCUS), Vision Statement, Contact info section, and Footer.

Navigation bar must feature logo, menu links (About, Businesses, Sectors, Capabilities, Future Focus, Company Profile, Contact), and 'Partner With NAMOA →' CTA button with data-testid='nav-partner-btn'.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all major interactive controls, links, chapter cards, and CTAs.
Contact section must contain registered address, phone, and email information without a form.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use dark full-screen backgrounds; respect the ~75% white/off-white light palette requirement.
Ensure high contrast for readability (APCA / WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).
Always specify hover state text colors explicitly (e.g., hover:bg-[#0B2742] hover:text-white).
Maintain strict data-testid conventions on buttons, links, cards, and input controls.
